mapper.select: SELECT FROM transport_task WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ORDER BY vehicle_id, updated_at DESC, id DESC

UPDATE transport_task SET status = #{status}, started_at = #{startedAt}, picked_up_at = #{pickedUpAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, failed_at = #{failedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE task_code = #{taskCode}
